column1: # Hand-checked decisions for kanji where the open evidence alone wasn't conclusive (tools/kanji_deck.py asks for them).
# use = the reading to lead with, or "keep" for the current one. Each note gives the common words behind the decision.

column3: note
みや is everyday (お宮, 宮崎); きゅう only wins through 宮殿 and 子宮
要素, 素材, 素直; す only comes from 素晴らしい and 素敵
収納, 納税, 納入; なっ is the sound change in 納得 and 納豆
ゆるい is the everyday word (緩い, 緩やか)
かける (駆ける) is the word on its own; く only in 駆使, 駆除
や; み only comes from 阿弥陀
たえる (堪える) is the word on its own; たん only in 堪能
ようやく (漸く) is the word on its own
only common word is 威嚇 (いかく)
哀愁, 郷愁
摩天楼, 楼閣
恩賜, 賜杯
修繕, 営繕
排斥
頒布
旺盛
附属
模倣
丙 (third in a series) is read へい
歌舞伎 (かぶき)
彫塑
開墾
氾濫
爪楊枝
琢磨
御苑, 外苑
もり is the reading in place names (杜の都); ず only comes from 杜撰
元禄
流暢
惣菜
彗星
わたし is the everyday "I"; わたくし is formal. Word counts can't tell them apart (same spelling)
一度, もう一度, 今度; たび is far rarer
有名, 有料; 有る is usually written ある in kana
医者, 学者; もの alone is rarer
ご飯, 夕飯; めし is rough, casual speech
居酒屋, 居間; 居る is usually written いる in kana
ご飯, 御主人; おん is old-fashioned
時差, 差別; 差す is rarer
平等, 等しい, 一等; ら is the plural suffix (彼等), usually written in kana
しく (敷く) is the word on its own; しき only in 敷地 and 屋敷
夜 on its own is よる (夜, 今夜は); よ only in compounds like 夜中. Word counts can't tell 夜 よる from 夜 よ (same spelling)
